# coolify_service_applications (Data Source)

Lists applications inside one compose service. Use an application's `uuid` with `coolify_service_application`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_service_applications" "example" {
  service_uuid = coolify_service.example.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_uuid` (String) UUID of the parent service.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) Compose applications on the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) Stored FQDN.
- `human_name` (String) Display name.
- `name` (String) Compose service name.
- `status` (String) Runtime status.
- `uuid` (String) Service application UUID.
